verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a commerce or payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only Square's hosted cloud APIs, a hosted Sandbox and SDKs. The locally runnable MCP server (`npx square-mcp-server start`) is an adjacent client tool that still calls Square's cloud APIs; it is not a self-hosted deployment of the core product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
